9111120c59ae4c37dc6a5ae07161d261.overview: E.B., the Easter Bunny's teenage son, heads to Hollywood, determined to become a drummer in a rock 'n' roll band. In L.A., he's taken in by Fred after the out-of-work slacker hits E.B. with his car.

915b655868bb51968dd0e5908d9b144a.overview: Private eye Jake Gittes lives off of the murky moral climate of sunbaked, pre-World War II Southern California. Hired by a beautiful socialite to investigate her husband's extra-marital affair, Gittes is swept into a maelstrom of double dealings and deadly deceits, uncovering a web of personal and political scandals that come crashing together.
915b655868bb51968dd0e5908d9b144a.tagline: You get tough. You get tender. You get close to each other. Maybe you even get close to the truth.

91a3a1b5453564c7a7083a208bb7a841.overview: A small-time hood must choose from among love, friendship and the chance to rise within the mob.
91a3a1b5453564c7a7083a208bb7a841.tagline: Go to church on Sunday. Go to Hell on Monday.

91bf638489f5ee6e2dd68909d7828e54.overview: When a young boy makes a wish at a carnival machine to be big, he wakes up the following morning to find that it has been granted and his body has grown older overnight, but he is still the same 13-year-old boy inside. Now he must learn how to cope with the unfamiliar world of grown-ups, including getting a job and having his first romantic encounter with a woman.
91bf638489f5ee6e2dd68909d7828e54.tagline: Have you ever had a really big secret?

91d61f6dc0e9d595a08db20a4c9728c4.overview: Two wanderers, a young man and a young woman, meet in the desert and decide to travel on together. The two travellers walk and hitch-hike their way down the road to their destination, the beach, becoming friends and lovers.
91d61f6dc0e9d595a08db20a4c9728c4.tagline: He and she were thumb-trippin'. They had the makin's... and the tail-end of summer.

91d7f28536fd66e99971844d03f89c16.overview: In the slums of Dublin during the Irish Civil War, the Boyle family’s fragile stability collapses after news of an unexpected inheritance lures them into a false sense of prosperity. Captain Boyle, a boastful idler, squanders their meager resources, while his wife Juno holds the household together. When the fortune proves illusory, the family faces ruin, betrayal, and tragedy.

91d848f8595caf7adc126f7a23dfe3f7.overview: Unexpected love blossoms when an assistant district attorney agrees to take a recidivist shoplifter home so she doesn't have to spend Christmas alone in jail.
91d848f8595caf7adc126f7a23dfe3f7.tagline: Barbara and Fred in 1940's first great love affair…!

91f7331dd5761114d0e033de2418d0e6.overview: A young rape victim tries desperately to pick up the pieces of her life, only to find herself at the mercy of a would-be rescuer.
91f7331dd5761114d0e033de2418d0e6.tagline: On the cinema horizon...something new...something unusual...something wild!

91f97725b77777d864b70d4746b9dfc3.overview: Year three at Hogwarts means new fun and new challenges as Harry learns the delicate art of approaching a Hippogriff, transforming shape-shifting Boggarts into hilarity and even turning back time. But the term also brings danger: soul-sucking Dementors hover over the school, an ally of the accursed He-Who-Cannot-Be-Named lurks within the castle walls, and fearsome wizard Sirius Black escapes Azkaban. And Harry will confront them all.

91f97b1103ab43ad9a17f613284aeb5f.overview: As Agnes slowly dies of cancer, her sisters are so immersed in their own psychic pains that they are unable to offer her the support she needs.
91f97b1103ab43ad9a17f613284aeb5f.tagline: Four women dressed in white in a mansion painted red... haunted by whispers and cries.
